_comment: Screw Drivers dedicated server (Windows build) under Wine. Game files come from Steam AppID 1279510, which requires a licensed account.
name: Screw Drivers
author: local@localhost
description: Dedicated server for Screw Drivers (Creactstudios). Ships only as a Windows build inside the paid depot 1279510, so it runs under Wine in this container. The server needs no Steam client at runtime: players connect by IP:PORT (Multiplayer -> Direct Connect) or via Noble Connect when enabled. The first player to join can be made host, or the server is claimed in-game with the host password printed on boot. The bundled ModTheIsland plugin (crash/DoS/exploit guards, bans) exposes an HTTP admin API and a web console at http://<node>:<admin port>/ - status, players, live chat, kick/ban, server and race settings, island switch, host commands, stop/restart - so the server can be managed without joining it. Allocate one UDP (game) and one TCP (admin) port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Pterodactyl install script for the Screw Drivers dedicated server.
# Runs in the egg's install image (ghcr.io/parkervcp/yolks:wine_10) with /mnt/server mounted.
#
# Two ways to get the game files:
#   1. STEAM_USERNAME/STEAM_PASSWORD of an account that owns Screw Drivers
#      (AppID 1279510) -> steamcmd pulls the Windows depot and only the
#      "Dedicated Server" folder is kept.
#   2. No credentials -> the files must already be in the volume (copy the
#      "Dedicated Server" folder from your own installation).
#
# start.sh and the mod are written FIRST, so a failed download still leaves a server
# that boots and tells you what is wrong instead of failing with "No such file".
#
# The __WRITE_*__ markers are replaced by tools/build_egg.py: __WRITE_START_SH__ becomes a
# heredoc with start.sh, __WRITE_PLUGIN_DLL__ becomes a download of ModTheIsland.dll from
# the public repo, verified against a sha256 baked into the egg.
set -uo pipefail

SERVER_DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
EXE="Screw Drivers Server.exe"
APP_ID="1279510"
BEPINEX_VERSION="5.4.23.6"
STEAMCMD_DIR="$SERVER_DIR/.steamcmd"
DOWNLOAD="$SERVER_DIR/.download"

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Screw Drivers dedicated server installer"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR"

have_files() { [[ -f "$SERVER_DIR/$EXE" ]]; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- start script
cat > "$SERVER_DIR/start.sh" <<'SD_START_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Screw Drivers dedicated server launcher (Windows build under Wine).
# Env-driven, crash-loop safe, SIGTERM aware. Same file is used by the Docker
# image (copied to /usr/local/bin) and by the Pterodactyl egg (installed into
# the server volume as ./start.sh), so keep it self-contained.
set -uo pipefail

APP_ID="${APP_ID:-1279510}"
EXE_NAME="Screw Drivers Server.exe"

log() { printf '[sd] %s\n' "$*"; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- environment
SERVER_DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-/home/container}"
if [[ ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/$EXE_NAME" && -f "$PWD/$EXE_NAME" ]]; then
	SERVER_DIR="$PWD"
fi
cd "$SERVER_DIR" || { log "cannot cd to $SERVER_DIR"; exit 1; }

SERVER_NAME="${SERVER_NAME:-Screw Drivers Server}"
SERVER_PASSWORD="${SERVER_PASSWORD:-}"
MAX_PLAYERS="${MAX_PLAYERS:-8}"
SERVER_PORT="${SERVER_PORT:-38000}"
HOST_STEAM_ID="${HOST_STEAM_ID:-0}"
ALLOW_FIRST_PLAYER_HOST="${ALLOW_FIRST_PLAYER_HOST:-0}"
NOBLE_CONNECT="${NOBLE_CONNECT:-0}"
EXTRA_ARGS="${EXTRA_ARGS:-}"
RESTART_ON_EXIT="${RESTART_ON_EXIT:-1}"

# Admin API (BepInEx mod). SD_ADMIN_* is what the plugin reads; ADMIN_* are aliases.
: "${SD_ADMIN_ENABLED:=${ADMIN_ENABLED:-1}}"
: "${SD_ADMIN_PORT:=${ADMIN_PORT:-38080}}"
: "${SD_ADMIN_BIND:=${ADMIN_BIND:-0.0.0.0}}"
: "${SD_ADMIN_TOKEN:=${ADMIN_TOKEN:-}}"
BEPINEX_SRC="${BEPINEX_SRC:-/opt/bepinex}"

export WINEPREFIX="${WINEPREFIX:-$SERVER_DIR/.wine}"
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="${WINEDLLOVERRIDES:-mscoree,mshtml=,winemenubuilder.exe=d}"
# Doorstop (BepInEx) hooks the game through its winhttp.dll proxy. Wine prefers its
# builtin winhttp, so the native copy next to the exe must be forced.
case "$WINEDLLOVERRIDES" in
	*winhttp=*) ;;
	*) export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b;${WINEDLLOVERRIDES}" ;;
esac

# The server splits arguments on whitespace, so spaces inside a value are
# encoded as [<SPACE>] (see ServerCommandLineParser in Assembly-CSharp).
encode_spaces() { printf '%s' "${1// /[<SPACE>]}"; }

build_args() {
	ARGS=(-batchmode -nographics -servername "$(encode_spaces "$SERVER_NAME")")
	[[ -n "$SERVER_PASSWORD" ]] && ARGS+=(-password "$(encode_spaces "$SERVER_PASSWORD")")
	ARGS+=(-port "$SERVER_PORT" -maxplayers "$MAX_PLAYERS" -logFile -)
	if [[ -n "$HOST_STEAM_ID" && "$HOST_STEAM_ID" != "0" ]]; then
		ARGS+=(-hostcsteamid "$HOST_STEAM_ID")
	elif [[ "$ALLOW_FIRST_PLAYER_HOST" == "1" ]]; then
		ARGS+=(-allowfirstplayerhost true)
	fi
	if [[ "$NOBLE_CONNECT" == "1" ]]; then
		ARGS+=(-nobleconnect true)
	else
		ARGS+=(-nobleconnect false)
	fi
	# shellcheck disable=SC2206 # deliberate word splitting for user supplied args
	[[ -n "$EXTRA_ARGS" ]] && ARGS+=($EXTRA_ARGS)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ preflight
if [[ ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/$EXE_NAME" ]]; then
	log "fatal: '$EXE_NAME' not found in $SERVER_DIR"
	log "put the game's 'Dedicated Server' folder contents into $SERVER_DIR"
	# Docker's restart policy would otherwise spin on this, so back off a bit.
	sleep "${FAIL_SLEEP:-30}"
	exit 1
fi
command -v wine > /dev/null || { log "fatal: wine not found in PATH"; sleep "${FAIL_SLEEP:-30}"; exit 1; }

# Display: the server runs with -nographics, but Wine is happier with an X
# server present. Start Xvfb locally if nobody provides a display.
if command -v Xvfb > /dev/null; then
	display="${DISPLAY:-:0}"
	display_number="${display#:}"
	display_number="${display_number%%.*}"
	if [[ ! -S "/tmp/.X11-unix/X${display_number}" ]]; then
		Xvfb "$display" -screen 0 "${DISPLAY_WIDTH:-1024}x${DISPLAY_HEIGHT:-768}x${DISPLAY_DEPTH:-16}" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
		export DISPLAY="$display"
		for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
			[[ -S "/tmp/.X11-unix/X${display_number}" ]] && break
			sleep 0.1
		done
	fi
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------- optional update
update_server() {
	local steamcmd="$SERVER_DIR/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh"
	if [[ ! -x "$steamcmd" ]]; then
		log "AUTO_UPDATE=1 but $steamcmd is missing, skipping update"
		return 0
	fi
	local download="$SERVER_DIR/.download"
	mkdir -p "$download"
	local auth=("$STEAM_USERNAME" "$STEAM_PASSWORD")
	[[ -n "${STEAM_GUARD_CODE:-}" ]] && auth+=("$STEAM_GUARD_CODE")
	log "updating via steamcmd (downloads the full ~9.3 GB client depot, then keeps only Dedicated Server)"
	(
		cd "$SERVER_DIR/.steamcmd" || exit 1
		HOME="$SERVER_DIR" "$steamcmd" +force_install_dir "$download" \
			+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +login "${auth[@]}" \
			+app_update "$APP_ID" validate +quit
	)
	if [[ -d "$download/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server" ]]; then
		cp -a "$download/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server/." "$SERVER_DIR/" && rm -rf "$download"
		log "update applied"
	else
		log "update did not produce a Dedicated Server folder, keeping current files"
	fi
}

if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
	if [[ -n "${STEAM_USERNAME:-}" ]]; then
		update_server
	else
		log "AUTO_UPDATE=1 but STEAM_USERNAME is unset (this AppID needs a licensed account), skipping update"
	fi
fi

# --------------------------------------------------------------- wine prefix
if [[ ! -f "$WINEPREFIX/.sd-prefix-ready" ]]; then
	if [[ -d /opt/wineprefix && ! -d "$WINEPREFIX" ]]; then
		log "installing pre-baked wine prefix into $WINEPREFIX"
		cp -a /opt/wineprefix "$WINEPREFIX" || true
		wineserver -w > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
	else
		log "initialising wine prefix at $WINEPREFIX (first start only, this takes a minute)"
		mkdir -p "$WINEPREFIX"
		wineboot -u > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
		wineserver -w > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
	fi
	touch "$WINEPREFIX/.sd-prefix-ready"
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------- admin api (BepInEx)
install_mod() {
	[[ -d "$BEPINEX_SRC" ]] || return 0
	local wanted=""
	[[ -f "$BEPINEX_SRC/.version" ]] && wanted="$(cat "$BEPINEX_SRC/.version")"
	local installed=""
	[[ -f "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/.sd-version" ]] && installed="$(cat "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/.sd-version")"

	if [[ ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/winhttp.dll" || ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/core/BepInEx.dll" || "$wanted" != "$installed" ]]; then
		log "installing BepInEx ${wanted:-unknown} into the server folder"
		cp -a "$BEPINEX_SRC/." "$SERVER_DIR/" || log "warning: could not copy BepInEx"
		[[ -n "$wanted" ]] && echo "$wanted" > "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/.sd-version"
	fi

	mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins"
	# The admin API used to ship as its own plugin; it lives in ModTheIsland now.
	rm -f "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins/ScrewDriversAdmin.dll"
	local plugin dest
	for plugin in "$BEPINEX_SRC"/plugins/*.dll; do
		[[ -f "$plugin" ]] || continue
		dest="$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins/$(basename "$plugin")"
		if [[ ! -f "$dest" ]]; then
			cp -a "$plugin" "$dest" || log "warning: could not install $(basename "$plugin")"
		elif ! cmp -s "$plugin" "$dest"; then
			log "updating $(basename "$plugin") in the server folder"
			cp -a "$plugin" "$dest" || log "warning: could not update $(basename "$plugin")"
		fi
	done
}

# Logs which mod file is about to be loaded: a missing or truncated DLL used to be silent
# (the API simply never answered), so say it out loud on every boot.
log_mod_state() {
	local plugin="$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins/ModTheIsland.dll"
	if [[ ! -f "$plugin" ]]; then
		log "mod         : ModTheIsland.dll MISSING - no admin API (reinstall the server)"
		return 0
	fi
	local bytes hash
	bytes="$(wc -c < "$plugin" | tr -d ' ')"
	hash="$(sha256sum "$plugin" 2> /dev/null | cut -c1-16)"
	log "mod         : ModTheIsland.dll ${bytes} bytes sha256 ${hash}"
	if [[ "$bytes" -lt 100000 ]]; then
		log "mod         : too small to be valid - truncated; reinstall or re-upload the mod"
	fi
}

if [[ "$SD_ADMIN_ENABLED" == "1" ]]; then
	install_mod
	log_mod_state
	if [[ -z "$SD_ADMIN_TOKEN" ]]; then
		SD_ADMIN_TOKEN="$(head -c 16 /dev/urandom 2> /dev/null | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
		[[ -n "$SD_ADMIN_TOKEN" ]] && log "no ADMIN_TOKEN set, generated one for this run"
	fi
else
	log "admin API disabled"
fi
export SD_ADMIN_ENABLED SD_ADMIN_PORT SD_ADMIN_BIND SD_ADMIN_TOKEN

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ run loop
build_args
log "server dir : $SERVER_DIR"
log "port/udp   : $SERVER_PORT"
log "name       : $SERVER_NAME"
log "max players: $MAX_PLAYERS"
log "password   : $([[ -n "$SERVER_PASSWORD" ]] && echo set || echo none)"
log "host       : $([[ -n "$HOST_STEAM_ID" && "$HOST_STEAM_ID" != 0 ]] && echo "steamid $HOST_STEAM_ID" || { [[ "$ALLOW_FIRST_PLAYER_HOST" == 1 ]] && echo "first player to join" || echo "claim with host_password.txt in-game"; })"
log "extra args : ${EXTRA_ARGS:-none}"
if [[ "$SD_ADMIN_ENABLED" == "1" ]]; then
	case "$SD_ADMIN_BIND" in
	0.0.0.0 | 127.0.0.1 | localhost | "::" | "*") ;;
	*)
		log "warning: admin bind address '$SD_ADMIN_BIND' does not exist inside this container"
		log "         set 'Admin Bind Address' to 0.0.0.0 - the daemon forwards the allocation for you"
		;;
	esac
	log "admin api  : bind $SD_ADMIN_BIND:$SD_ADMIN_PORT (container-internal; publish/forward it outside)"
	log "             token: $SD_ADMIN_TOKEN"
	log "             curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SD_ADMIN_TOKEN' http://127.0.0.1:$SD_ADMIN_PORT/status"
else
	log "admin api  : disabled"
fi

STOPPING=0
WINE_PID=""

# Polls the admin API from inside the container so a dead API is a log line, not a
# silent "why can't the panel reach it". Runs in the background while wine boots.
admin_api_selfcheck() {
	local tries=0 code=""
	while [[ $tries -lt 90 ]]; do
		sleep 1
		tries=$((tries + 1))
		code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 2 "http://127.0.0.1:${SD_ADMIN_PORT}/health" 2> /dev/null || true)"
		if [[ -n "$code" && "$code" != "000" ]]; then
			log "admin api  : answering on 127.0.0.1:${SD_ADMIN_PORT} (HTTP ${code})"
			return 0
		fi
	done
	log "admin api  : NOT answering on 127.0.0.1:${SD_ADMIN_PORT} after 90s - check, in this order:"
	log "             1. Admin Bind Address is 0.0.0.0 (not the node's public IP); it is '$SD_ADMIN_BIND'"
	log "             2. the mod is installed: $SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins/ModTheIsland.dll"
	log "             3. it answers locally but not outside: the daemon must publish that TCP port"
	log "                (an allocation) and its firewall must allow it"
}

shutdown() {
	[[ "$STOPPING" == "1" ]] && return
	STOPPING=1
	log "shutdown requested"
	if [[ -n "$WINE_PID" ]] && kill -0 "$WINE_PID" 2> /dev/null; then
		kill -TERM "$WINE_PID" 2> /dev/null
		for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
			kill -0 "$WINE_PID" 2> /dev/null || break
			sleep 0.5
		done
		kill -KILL "$WINE_PID" 2> /dev/null
	fi
	wineserver -k > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
	log "stopped"
	exit 0
}

trap shutdown TERM INT

# Pterodactyl sends its stop command on stdin; accept the usual spellings.
# Background subshells get /dev/null as stdin, so hand the real stdin over as fd 3.
if [[ "${STDIN_COMMANDS:-1}" == "1" ]] && exec 3<&0 2> /dev/null; then
	(
		while IFS= read -r line <&3; do
			case "${line,,}" in
				stop | shutdown | quit | exit) log "stop command received"; kill -TERM $$ ;;
			esac
		done
		exec 3<&-
	) &
fi

delay=5
while :; do
	started=$SECONDS
	log "launching wine $EXE_NAME ${ARGS[*]}"
	wine "$EXE_NAME" "${ARGS[@]}" &
	WINE_PID=$!
	if [[ "$SD_ADMIN_ENABLED" == "1" ]]; then
		admin_api_selfcheck &
	fi
	wait "$WINE_PID"
	rc=$?
	WINE_PID=""
	wineserver -w > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
	[[ "$STOPPING" == "1" ]] && exit 0

	if [[ -f "$SERVER_DIR/.sd-stop" ]]; then
		rm -f "$SERVER_DIR/.sd-stop"
		log "stop requested through the admin API, not restarting"
		exit 0
	fi

	uptime=$((SECONDS - started))
	if [[ "$RESTART_ON_EXIT" != "1" ]]; then
		log "server exited with code $rc after ${uptime}s (RESTART_ON_EXIT=0), exiting"
		exit "$rc"
	fi
	# Crash loops are throttled, long sessions start over with a short delay.
	[[ $uptime -ge 300 ]] && delay=5
	log "server exited with code $rc after ${uptime}s, restarting in ${delay}s"
	sleep "$delay" &
	wait $!
	delay=$((delay * 2))
	[[ $delay -gt 60 ]] && delay=60
done
SD_START_EOF
chmod +x "$SERVER_DIR/start.sh"

# --------------------------------------------------------------- server mod
echo "installing BepInEx $BEPINEX_VERSION"
if curl -fsSL -o /tmp/bepinex.zip \
	"https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/download/v${BEPINEX_VERSION}/BepInEx_win_x64_${BEPINEX_VERSION}.zip"; then
	rm -rf /tmp/bepinex-extract
	if unzip -q /tmp/bepinex.zip -d /tmp/bepinex-extract; then
		cp -a /tmp/bepinex-extract/. "$SERVER_DIR/" || echo "warning: could not copy BepInEx into place"
	else
		echo "warning: could not unpack BepInEx"
	fi
	rm -rf /tmp/bepinex.zip /tmp/bepinex-extract
else
	echo "warning: BepInEx download failed, the admin API will be unavailable"
fi

mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins"
rm -f "$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins/ScrewDriversAdmin.dll"   # superseded by ModTheIsland
echo "installing the server mod (174080 bytes)"
plugin_dir="$SERVER_DIR/BepInEx/plugins"
plugin="$plugin_dir/ModTheIsland.dll"
mkdir -p "$plugin_dir"
rm -f "$plugin_dir/ScrewDriversAdmin.dll"
if curl -fsSL -o "$plugin.tmp" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ras-rap/screw-drivers-server/main/dist/ModTheIsland.dll"; then
	if [ "$(sha256sum "$plugin.tmp" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "abbe2e62df8bde203a1ab4919c6b227e00889998cf4352ef8dea2bc6fbd57fa8" ]; then
		mv -f "$plugin.tmp" "$plugin"
		chmod 0644 "$plugin"
		echo "mod installed: $(wc -c < "$plugin" | tr -d ' ') bytes, sha256 verified"
	else
		echo "warning: the downloaded ModTheIsland.dll has the wrong sha256"
		echo "         expected: abbe2e62df8bde203a1ab4919c6b227e00889998cf4352ef8dea2bc6fbd57fa8"
		echo "         got:      $(sha256sum "$plugin.tmp" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
		echo "         the repository moved on - download the latest egg and reinstall"
		rm -f "$plugin.tmp"
	fi
else
	echo "warning: could not download ModTheIsland.dll - the admin API will be unavailable"
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- game files
# steamcmd installs into whichever library it decides on (force_install_dir is not
# always honoured, and HOME=$SERVER_DIR makes it use $SERVER_DIR/Steam), so look for
# the "Dedicated Server" folder in every place it can land - including a tree that a
# previous attempt already left behind.
find_game_files() {
	local candidate
	for candidate in \
		"$SERVER_DIR/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server" \
		"$DOWNLOAD/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server" \
		"$DOWNLOAD/steamapps/common/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server" \
		"$SERVER_DIR/Steam/steamapps/common/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server"; do
		if [[ -d "$candidate" ]]; then
			printf '%s' "$candidate"
			return 0
		fi
	done
	find "$SERVER_DIR" -maxdepth 6 -type d -name "Dedicated Server" -print -quit 2>/dev/null
}

adopt_game_files() {
	local source="$1"
	echo "found the server files in ${source#"$SERVER_DIR"/}"
	cp -a "$source/." "$SERVER_DIR/" || return 1
	# Drop steamcmd's library (the full 9.3 GB client depot) and the scratch download.
	rm -rf "$DOWNLOAD"
	case "$source" in
	"$SERVER_DIR"/Steam/*) rm -rf "$SERVER_DIR/Steam" ;;
	esac
	return 0
}

fetch_steamcmd() {
	mkdir -p "$STEAMCMD_DIR"
	echo "downloading steamcmd"
	curl -fsSL -o /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" || return 1
	tar -xzf /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz -C "$STEAMCMD_DIR" || return 1
	mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR/steamapps"
	chmod +x "$STEAMCMD_DIR/steamcmd.sh"
}

fetch_game_files() {
	local auth=("$STEAM_USERNAME" "$STEAM_PASSWORD")
	[[ -n "${STEAM_GUARD_CODE:-}" ]] && auth+=("$STEAM_GUARD_CODE")

	rm -rf "$DOWNLOAD"
	mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD"

	echo "downloading AppID $APP_ID (Windows depot, ~9.3 GB, only 'Dedicated Server' is kept)"
	(
		cd "$STEAMCMD_DIR" || exit 1
		HOME="$SERVER_DIR" ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "$DOWNLOAD" \
			+login "${auth[@]}" +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows \
			+app_update "$APP_ID" validate +quit
	) 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log

	local found
	found="$(find_game_files)"
	if [[ -z "$found" ]]; then
		echo
		echo "steamcmd finished but no 'Dedicated Server' folder turned up. Looked in:"
		echo "  $SERVER_DIR/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server"
		echo "  $DOWNLOAD/... and $SERVER_DIR/Steam/steamapps/common/Screw Drivers/Dedicated Server"
		grep -qi "no subscription" /tmp/steamcmd.log && echo "The account does not own Screw Drivers (AppID $APP_ID)."
		grep -qi "steam guard" /tmp/steamcmd.log && echo "Steam Guard was requested - set STEAM_GUARD_CODE and reinstall."
		return 1
	fi
	adopt_game_files "$found"
}

if [[ -n "${STEAM_USERNAME:-}" && -n "${STEAM_PASSWORD:-}" ]]; then
	echo "using steam account: $STEAM_USERNAME"
	fetch_steamcmd || { echo "fatal: could not install steamcmd"; exit 1; }
	fetch_game_files || { echo "fatal: could not download the dedicated server (see above)"; exit 1; }
else
	existing="$(find_game_files)"
	if [[ -n "$existing" ]]; then
		echo "no Steam credentials given, adopting the files already in the volume"
		adopt_game_files "$existing" || echo "warning: could not copy the existing files into place"
	fi
fi

if ! have_files; then
	cat << 'MSG'

fatal: no game files yet.

Screw Drivers is a paid game and Valve ships the dedicated server inside the
normal game depot (AppID 1279510), so there is no anonymous download. Either:

  A) set STEAM_USERNAME / STEAM_PASSWORD (and STEAM_GUARD_CODE the first time) in the
     startup variables and run the installer again - the account must own the game; or

  B) copy the folder "Dedicated Server" from your own installation
     (Steam\steamapps\common\Screw Drivers\Dedicated Server) into this server's file
     manager / SFTP root, so that "Screw Drivers Server.exe" ends up directly in
     /home/container, then run the installer again.

start.sh and the mod are already installed, so after uploading you can start the
server right away.

MSG
	exit 1
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- wine prefix
# Build the prefix now instead of on the first start: the install image is the same
# wine image, so this moves ~1.4 GB of one-time work off the boot path.
export WINEPREFIX="$SERVER_DIR/.wine"
if [[ ! -f "$WINEPREFIX/.sd-prefix-ready" ]]; then
	echo "initialising wine prefix in $WINEPREFIX (one-time step, a few minutes)"
	mkdir -p "$WINEPREFIX"
	WINEDEBUG=-all wineboot -u > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
	WINEDEBUG=-all wineserver -w > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
	touch "$WINEPREFIX/.sd-prefix-ready"
else
	echo "wine prefix already initialised"
fi

echo "setting permissions"
chown -R container:container "$SERVER_DIR" 2> /dev/null || chown -R 1000:1000 "$SERVER_DIR" 2> /dev/null || true

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "installed: $(du -sh "$SERVER_DIR" 2> /dev/null | cut -f1) in $SERVER_DIR"
ls -1 "$SERVER_DIR" | head -12
echo "start the server from the panel; it binds its UDP port in under a minute"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Shown in the in-game server list and join screen. Spaces are fine.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: Host Steam ID
variables.description: SteamID64 that becomes host automatically. 0 = no automatic host.

variables.name: Allow First Player Host
variables.description: 1 = whoever connects first becomes host. Ignored when Host Steam ID is set.

variables.name: Noble Connect
variables.description: 1 = host through the Noble Connect relay instead of direct UDP (use when you cannot forward the port).

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Appended verbatim to the server command line, e.g. -ip 0.0.0.0

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = run steamcmd before every start. Requires the Steam credentials below and ~10 GB free space.

variables.name: Admin API
variables.description: 1 = enable the bundled HTTP admin API (BepInEx mod).

variables.name: Admin Port
variables.description: TCP port of the admin API. Simplest: put the game port here too (the allocation is published for TCP and UDP, the game only uses UDP) and you need just one allocation; otherwise allocate a second port and set it here. Must match a published allocation or nothing external can reach it.

variables.name: Admin Bind Address
variables.description: Leave this at 0.0.0.0. The container cannot bind the node's public IP - the daemon forwards the allocation for you, so anything else makes the admin API unreachable. Set 127.0.0.1 only to keep the API inside the container.

variables.name: Admin Token
variables.description: Bearer token for the admin API. Empty generates a random one per boot, printed in the console.

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Account that owns Screw Drivers. Used by the installer and by auto update.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code
variables.description: Only for the first steamcmd login from a new IP. Clear it afterwards.
